target_customer: Consumers wanting to create, answer and discuss polls, with anonymous posting
problem: Easy social polling: ask a crowd a question and get answers and comments, optionally anonymously.
business_model: Consumer web site; no revenue model found

founders.name: Fred Zhang
founders.background_notes: YC bio lists later ventures in medical funding/longevity, US Heartland real estate and PrepScholar and says he is a Summer 2006 alumnus. Other founders not named in sources found.

technical_complexity.rationale: A social polling web site with anonymous questions and comments is basic web application work for 2006.

defensibility.rationale: Polling features are trivially copyable; value would depend on a user community, and none is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found. A TechCrunch item the search surfaced concerns Facebook pulling polls, but its date and relevance to Pollground were not read, so it is not used.

market_need_then: No evidence of demand found; the only source is the YC directory description.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, reviews or community discussion of Pollground were found; searches for the name returned only unrelated polling products.

outcome_analysis: Pollground was a Summer 2006 YC consumer polling site with a Boston base and one named founder, now listed as inactive. No shutdown date, cause, funding, traffic or acquisition was found in any source, so the cause of failure is not public; the setting (a consumer product with no stated revenue model and trivially copyable features in the early social web) is context only, not a sourced finding.
notes: Outcome search found no shutdown report; the cause and date of shutdown are not public in sources found, so failure_factors is left empty. Directory status Inactive, exit type shutdown with unknown date. Funding search returned only unrelated companies (Pollfish, Pollen), so funding_data_coverage is none_found, not zero. Competitor search with date terms returned nothing about Pollground or dated competitors, so the list is empty. Branding search returned nothing relevant. Founded year not stated. A different YC company, Polly (S17), is inactive and unrelated. Only the YC page and an aggregator confirm the batch. Web Archive skipped.
